findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic and placeholder code in research commands

evidence.observation: Multiple Phase 5 TODO comments indicating uncompleted authorization checking and memory integration
TODO placeholder for querying quality_anomalies table with empty default array

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures complete authorization enforcement and functional anomaly retrieval in platform runtime.

findings.title: Missing Model Router Call Log File

evidence.observation: call_log_exists is false for router log path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router creates and writes invocation metrics to call_log.jsonl on startup or first request.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model router latency, call volume, and failure rates.

findings.title: Direct LLM API calls bypass model router in emergency alert processing

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral via environment API keys rather than querying router endpoint

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM synthesis requests through the model router service at port 8891 rather than calling third-party provider SDKs directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes rate limiting, failover routing, cost monitoring, and telemetry through the model router.
